prompt: He comments out half the code; the bug goes away, so it's in that half.
why: Halving the search space finds the broken part fast. That's narrowing it down.
trap: It's one change, but the aim is to halve the search.

prompt: She cut the page down to the smallest example that still shows the bug.
tells: the smallest example that still shows the bug
why: Removing everything unneeded leaves just the cause.
trap: Reproducing came first; this shrinks it.

prompt: He checks the data after each stage of the pipeline to see where it goes wrong.
tells: after each stage of the pipeline
why: Checking step by step locates the broken stage.
trap: He prints values, but the method is narrowing.

prompt: Git bisect tries commits halfway between good and bad until it finds the one that broke it.
why: Binary search through commits is narrowing it down.
trap: It's about changes, but the method is halving.

prompt: Turning off extensions one group at a time shows which one breaks the site.
why: Splitting into groups narrows down the cause.
trap: It's careful changes, but the goal is finding the culprit.

prompt: She checks the API response first to see whether the bug is in the server or the page.
tells: whether the bug is in the server or the page
why: Deciding which half has the bug is narrowing it down.
trap: She looks at values, but to choose a side.
